text:
zoe: Quick note from mirror runs: our int4 candidate emits duplicate func_call starts in about 2.4% of sessions. Not parse failures — adapter sees two starts, often same semantics but different temp ids.
michael: Saw that too. Pattern: first emission is short/chopped, second is longer chunk that completes the call. Often the second arrives after a runtime retry.
tara: Could be interplay of KV warmup (longer initial token latency) + runtime retry budget. Any examples?
zoe: Example (sanitized):
```
[2026-04-02T10:12:11Z] recv chunk seq=0 {"call":"geo_lookup","args":{"q":"Main St"},"_chunk":"t=0..18"}
[runtime] retry due to ack_timeout tmp=tmp42
[2026-04-02T10:12:11Z] recv chunk seq=1 {"call":"geo_lookup","args":{"q":"Main St"},"_chunk":"t=0..46"}
```
adapter treats as two starts because temp id != tmp id.
michael: Short-term mitigation ideas: 1) semantic fingerprinting (sorted-keys canonicalize + escape-normalize + strip trailing commas) hashed with xxhash64; dedupe within a sliding window (5s). 2) add lightweight token-anchor: have runtime emit a small stable anchor token with func_call start (e.g., __anchor:v1) preserved across retries so adapter can match.
tara: Anchors sound nice but need runtime change. Fingerprint is faster to ship. Danger: colliding different-args calls or suppressing legitimate retry with updated args.
michael: Add arg-diff threshold (normalized edit distance > 0.03 => treat distinct) and metric suppressed_retry. Also add a short idempotency window so fingerprints only dedupe if within 6s.
zoe: For canonicalization we need to handle escape variants (\n vs \u000A), multiple whitespace, and unicode normalization (NFC). Tokenizer differences matter: small tokenization deltas can produce differing chunk boundaries but canonical JSON should match.
tara: Also be careful about JSON-repair heuristics that insert braces or commas and hide the original chunking issue. Keep raw payloads.
michael: Plan: run a 1% AB on raven-int4-canary with flag fp_dedupe=true for 12h. Mirror harness should sample 25k sessions and store ~150 raw+repaired artifacts in restricted bucket for analysis.
zoe: I'll wire the harness and add telemetry: metric duplicate_tool_start, tokenization_delta_hist, suppressed_retry_count, avg_first_emit_latency.
michael: Also add a small experiment with anchors on a staging runtime (no production traffic) to validate anchor propagation across retries. If anchors survive retries, long-term plan: move idempotency token generation into runtime to avoid heuristics.
tara: Ops check: confirm downstream tool services tolerate duplicate_tool_start idempotently. If not, add quick debounce/circuit-breaker.
ops-bot: @zoe Deployment requested: raven-int4-canary flag=fp_dedupe=true scope=1% queued.
zoe: Will post first metrics after 200k mirrored requests (~3h). If duplicate rate doesn't drop by an order of magnitude, we revert and schedule runtime anchor work.
michael: Nice. Also add a unit test corpus of chunked reconstructions that must canonicalize to same fingerprint (include tricky escapes and trailing-comma cases).
tara: Thanks team — abort AB immediately if latency or error rate increases. :warning:
zoe: Closing until we have numbers.
